Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, calling for the concerned records relating to the order dated 01.07.2025 in O.A. No. 656 of 2025 and quash the same in so far as it failed to grant the interim relief prayed for and consequently direct the respondents to permit the applicant to submit manual application to the post of Pharmacist pending disposal of the main Original Application consider their for recruitment to the post of Pharmacist

judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

P. Velmurugan, J.:— The learned counsel on record for the petitioners would submit that the relief sought for in the writ petition has become infructuous. Recording his statement, this writ petition is dismissed as infructuous. Consequently, WMP No. 28241 of 2025 is closed. No costs.
